Another thing actually is the new rule change around having your whole lineage revealed throughout the event.

So unlike before, where if you see random Fire Spirit, and now you have to think, hmm, draw 7 pass, or 8 cards pass, are they creative shock into float, or are they fire aggro, double Vermillion Decree, you die.
Now at least you have the ability to see your opponent's lineage, so this is a rule change that was announced just yesterday.
